canonicalPolicy.rule: This embedded file is an exact snapshot of the canonical desktop policy. Mobile-specific code must not redefine business eligibility, pacing, blacklist, deduplication, completion, or safety rules independently.

executionProfile.ocrPolicy: Use OCR only for the smallest unresolved region after AX fails or lacks the required semantic field. Do not full-screen OCR on every step.
executionProfile.coordinatePolicy: Raw coordinates are a last-resort action target derived from fresh local evidence only; never persist screen coordinates in the skill.
